estimation_reasoning_summary: The function contains a deterministic loop executing 32 iterations (STAR_TRANSFER_SIZE). Each iteration performs a 1-byte read from SRAM, a 1-byte write to SRAM, and an 8-bit to 32-bit addition for checksum. Under -O0 optimization on Cortex-M4F, each loop iteration takes ~35 cycles due to stack reload/store operations for local variables. 32 iterations yield ~1120 cycles plus ~32 cycles for function entry/exit and post-loop bitwise XOR operations, resulting in ~1152 nominal cycles (24.0 us at 48 MHz).
assumptions: SRAM access is zero wait-state for data reads/writes
Loop iteration count is exactly 32 as fixed by STAR_TRANSFER_SIZE constant
Stack-based local variable loads and stores occur without cache or bus contention
